readme:
![](icon.png)
# KinCreator for V Rising
KinCreator lets you save your character's appearance as presets and load them back whenever you create a character or use a castle mirror.

*Never lose the look you love.*

---
Thanks to the V Rising modding and server communities for ideas and requests!

This was a collaborative effort from Odjit (Dj) and Zfolmt [(Mitch)](https://www.patreon.com/join/4865914). Feel free to reach out to either of us if you have questions or need help with the mod!

[V Rising Modding Discord](https://vrisingmods.com/discord) | [How to Install Mods on BepInEx](https://wiki.vrisingmods.com/user/Mod_Install.html)

## Features

### Appearance Presets
- **Save New Preset** stores your current appearance as a new preset, prompting you for a name (prefilled with the next "Preset N").
- **Load Preset** applies a saved preset from the dropdown, and names your character after the preset on confirm.
- **Edit** overwrites a preset with your current appearance (Save Edit) or renames it; the same button becomes **Back** to leave edit mode.
- **Delete** removes the selected preset after a confirmation prompt.
- Works in both new character creation and the in-game mirror customization.
- Presets are saved to disk, so they persist between sessions.

### Auto Reconnect
- When you try to join a full server, KinCreator automatically retries the connection for you.
- Configurable in the mod's config file (toggle, retry interval).

- Deleting a preset now asks for confirmation first
- Added a gold highlight to the preset controls so it's clear which preset you're editing
- The Complete button is no longer hidden while using the preset menu
- Fixed the Save Edit label sometimes reverting while still in edit mode
- Fixed the rename/name popup occasionally disabling its Confirm button
